title: 4521-MOM-LOI-039-062-0003-GAR Rev02 Operational Limits
summary: This document outlines operational limits for the Oil to Salt Heat Exchanger at Solana Thermosolar Power Plant, including design conditions, thermal shock, temperature ramps, mass flow rates, and special considerations for the drain with N2.
